fullPassage:
In a small town known for its flourishing academic community, two brothers, James and Daniel Carter, stood out for their exceptional effort and talent. James and his younger brother, Daniel, both applied for the Spark Fellowship. The Spark Fellowship was a highly respected program that selects and supports outstanding students every two years. Unsurprisingly, both brothers advanced to the final round.
Without Daniel knowing, James went to the selection committee. He told the committee, "Daniel has always been the more dedicated and talented one. He will excel in this program like no one else." Meanwhile, Daniel had the same idea as his older brother. He believed that his brother was the more ideal and deserving candidate. He also decided to visit and speak to the committee.
However, the program had a strict rule: only one family member could be selected in the same year. This posed a challenge to the selection committee, who thought it almost impossible to choose between the two equally impressive candidates. The committee gathered together, struggling all day long to decide. When James found out about this rule, he tried to seek a way to demonstrate Daniel's exceptional talent to the selection committee.
Not long after James had left, Daniel showed up at the selection committee and advocated for his brother, saying "James' leadership and vision make him the perfect choice. He deserves this chance more than I do." Moved by their selflessness, the committee made an exception by selecting both brothers in the same year, for the first time in its history. Their story inspired others, showing that true success lies not only in individual achievements but also in supporting and encouraging others.

questions.passage: In a small town __________ for its flourishing academic community, two brothers, James and Daniel Carter, stood out for their exceptional effort and talent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "a small town + 과거분사(known)" → 알려진 마을. 과거분사가 명사를 수식.
det.analysis:
✅ ② known: 과거분사 → "~로 알려진" (수동)
❌ ① know: 동사원형
❌ ③ knowing: 현재분사 → 능동 의미
❌ ④ to know: to부정사
det.tip: a town known for = ~로 알려진 마을 (과거분사의 후치수식)

questions.passage: The Spark Fellowship was a highly respected program that __________ and supports outstanding students every two years.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 관계대명사 that의 선행사 a program(단수) → 단수 동사 selects
det.analysis:
✅ ① selects: 선행사 a program = 단수 → 단수 동사
❌ ② select: 복수
❌ ③ selecting: 분사
❌ ④ selected: 과거/과거분사
det.tip: a program that selects and supports = 선발하고 지원하는 프로그램

questions.passage: James went to the selection committee. He told the committee, "Daniel has always been the more dedicated and talented one." ... He believed that his brother was the more ideal and deserving candidate. ... However, the program had a strict rule: only one family member could be selected in the same year. This posed a challenge to the selection committee, who thought it almost impossible to choose between the two equally impressive candidates. The committee gathered together, struggling all day long to decide. When James found out about this rule, he tried to seek a way to demonstrate Daniel's exceptional talent to the selection committee. Not long after James had left, Daniel showed up at the selection committee and advocated for his brother, saying "James' leadership and vision make him the perfect choice."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 him이 가리키는 대상으로 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Daniel이 형(James)을 옹호하며 "James의 리더십과 비전이 그를(him = James) 완벽한 선택으로 만든다"고 말함.
det.analysis: him = James: Daniel이 James를 추천하는 문맥
det.tip: make him the perfect choice → him = James (Daniel이 추천하는 대상)

questions.passage: Not long after James __________, Daniel showed up at the selection committee and advocated for his brother.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "Not long after + 과거완료" → James가 떠난 후(선행 동작) Daniel이 나타남(후행 동작). 과거완료 had left가 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ② had left: 과거완료 → showed up보다 먼저 일어난 동작
❌ ① leave: 원형
❌ ③ has left: 현재완료 → 과거 시제 문맥에 부적절
❌ ④ was leaving: 진행형 → 완료 의미 필요
det.tip: after + 과거완료(had p.p.) = ~한 후에 (시간 선후 관계)

questions.passage: In a small town known for its flourishing academic community, two brothers, James and Daniel Carter, stood out for their exceptional effort and talent. James and his younger brother, Daniel, both applied for the Spark Fellowship. The Spark Fellowship was a highly respected program that selects and supports ①<u>outstanding</u> students every two years. ... However, the program ④ had a strict rule: only one family member could be ②<u>selecting</u> in the same year. This posed a challenge to the selection committee, who thought it almost ③<u>impossible</u> to choose between the two equally impressive candidates.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② selecting → selected: "could be + 과거분사" 수동태 구조에서 과거분사 selected가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ② selecting: 수동태 → could be selected(선발될 수 있다)
✅ ① outstanding: 형용사 → students 수식 → 올바름
✅ ③ impossible: 형용사 → "it is impossible to" 구조 → 올바름
det.tip: could be + p.p.(수동태): could be selected = 선발될 수 있다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: "both brothers advanced to the final round" → 두 형제 모두 최종 라운드에 진출.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 원문과 일치
❌ ① James는 Daniel을 추천하러 감
❌ ③ James가 먼저 감
❌ ④ struggling all day long = 쉽지 않았음
det.tip: 내용 일치: both brothers advanced to the final round

ch: James는 자신이 선발되기 위해 위원회에 갔다.
두 형제 모두 Spark Fellowship 최종 라운드에 진출했다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: James가 먼저 위원회에 갔고 Daniel이 나중에 나타남 → "Daniel이 먼저"는 사실과 반대.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ James가 먼저 → Daniel이 나중에
✅ ① every two years = 격년
✅ ② strict rule: only one family member
✅ ③ 서로를 추천 = 양보
det.tip: 시간 순서: James 먼저 → Daniel 나중

ch: 한 가족에서 한 명만 선발할 수 있는 규정이 있었다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 교훈으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "true success lies not only in individual achievements but also in supporting and encouraging others"
det.analysis:
✅ ② 원문 마지막 문장과 일치
❌ ① 재능만: 아님
❌ ③ 경쟁: 양보
❌ ④ 규칙 불변: 예외를 둠
❌ ⑤ 항상 옳다: 언급 없음
det.tip: 핵심: supporting and encouraging others = 타인 지지와 격려

ch: 재능이 뛰어난 사람만이 성공할 수 있다.
진정한 성공은 개인 성취뿐 아니라 타인을 지지하는 데에도 있다.
형제 간의 경쟁이 더 나은 결과를 낳는다.
